lead.headline: Share of ICE jail-hold requests (detainers) on people with a criminal conviction fell from 43% to 16%, FY23 to FY26
lead.number: 43% (October-March FY23) to 16% (October-March FY26), same months both years; FY25 was 33% on matching months.
lead.watch_out: The drop lands exactly where one yearly file ends and the next begins, and the FY26 file was cut on 2026-03-11.

Most Targets of Detainers Had No Criminal Convictions In general, individuals with a criminal conviction made up a surprisingly small number of those targeted by a detainer. Out of 17,972 detainers issued between January 20 and February 17, just 28 percent had any prior conviction. Of these, despite this administration’s rhetoric, only 30 detainers were targeted at convicted rapists and just 65 at murderers. [6] Figure 2.
